visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a modern, sunlit living room with light wood flooring, two young girls are seen playing on the floor near a cat's water fountain. One girl wears a blue t-shirt and dark shorts with pigtails, while the other wears a white t-shirt and checkered shorts. A small puddle of water is visible on the floorboards next to the white ceramic fountain stand. (2) The girls start wiping the wet floor using grey and green microfiber towels. An adult woman wearing a striped top and beige overalls enters the frame, carrying a white bowl. She stands over them, observing their cleaning efforts. The girls crawl around, diligently scrubbing the wood with their small hands. (3) The camera follows the girl in the blue shirt as she stands up and moves toward a white wall with an electrical outlet and black power cords. She uses her wet grey towel to wipe the wall and the area around the plug. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the wall and towel. (4) A dramatic camera angle shift occurs, placing the lens at a very low level looking up. The girl in the blue shirt approaches the camera and wipes the lens directly with her towel, temporarily blurring the view. In the background, the woman and the other girl are seen still engaged in the cleaning task. (5) The girl in the white shirt joins in wiping the wall with her green towel. The woman reaches out to take the towels back as they finish. The girls then transition to a red and wooden rocking horse toy located in a hallway area, vigorously wiping its surface. (6) The video concludes with a solid pink screen featuring a small cartoon illustration of a girl holding a strawberry, with the text POPO'S DAILY LIFE displayed below.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic BGM featuring pizzicato strings and a light piano melody. A female voice with a warm, professional yet parental tone speaks in Traditional Chinese, commenting on the children playing with water. Subtle rustling sounds of fabric are layered over the music. (2) The voices of the two young girls enter, characterized by high pitch and high arousal. They repeatedly exclaim He-xiu with rhythmic intensity, mimicking the sound of making an effort. The acoustic BGM remains steady at approximately 100 BPM, providing a playful rhythmic backbone to their scrubbing sounds. (3) Sharp, percussive slapping sounds are heard as a wet towel hits a hard surface, followed by muffled rubbing noises. The adult female's voice rises slightly in pitch, expressing amusement and mock-instruction. The spectral brightness is high, emphasizing the clarity of the kids' chirpy vocalizations. (4) The soundscape becomes more dynamic as the girls move around; footsteps on wood and the rustle of towels are clearly audible. The adult continues to interact with them, her voice showing high valence and moderate dominance. The BGM maintains a consistent major key feel, reinforcing the wholesome atmosphere. (5) As the activity shifts to the toy, the intensity of the He-xiu vocalizations increases momentarily before the voices and BGM are cleanly cross-faded out. A final short spoken phrase concludes the track over the ending graphic, with high signal-to-noise ratio throughout.
